name: Corning 3610 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning 96 well flat clear bottom white polystyrene TC-treated microplate, individually wrapped, with lid, sterile. Dimensions from the Corning 'Microplate Dimensions 96/384/1536' sheet, row '96 well flat bottom' under 'Black/white with clear bottom, polystyrene plates'. Units in meters. Geometrically identical to the Corning 3599 except for the bottom: this plate has a 0.5 mm clear polystyrene bottom (vs 1.27 mm on the 3599), so the outside surface of the well floor sits 3.03 mm above the plate datum instead of 2.26 mm - a 0.77 mm working-distance shift that matters when swapping between the two. Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm. Plate footprint 127.76 x 85.48 x 14.22 mm per the Corning and Falcon Microplates Selection Guide (CLS-C-DL-MP-014REV9), stated by Corning to meet the ANSI/SBS footprint standard. A1 well center is 14.3 mm from the left edge and 11.2 mm from the top edge. Well top diameter 6.86 mm, bottom diameter 6.35 mm, depth 10.67 mm, flat bottom. Well bottom area 0.3165 cm^2, flange/skirt height 6.096 mm. Total well volume 360 uL, working volume 75-200 uL. White body with clear bottom for luminescence and fluorescence reads. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
